pitch_en: Deploys off-grid and on-grid solar systems for rural communities, schools, and telecom towers across Colombia.
pitch_es: Despliega sistemas solares fuera y dentro de la red para comunidades rurales, escuelas y torres de telecomunicaciones en Colombia.
cta_pitch_en: Solar energy as a platform for rural development, education, and water access across Colombia.
cta_pitch_es: Energia solar como plataforma para desarrollo rural, educacion y acceso al agua en Colombia.

sections.head_en: Remote Colombian communities and critical infrastructure often lack reliable grid electricity and bundled essential services (water, connectivity, education).
sections.head_es: Comunidades remotas e infraestructura critica en Colombia a menudo carecen de electricidad confiable de red y servicios esenciales integrados (agua, conectividad, educacion).
sections.body_en: Remote Colombian communities and critical infrastructure often lack reliable grid electricity and bundled essential services (water, connectivity, education).
sections.body_es: Comunidades remotas e infraestructura critica en Colombia a menudo carecen de electricidad confiable de red y servicios esenciales integrados (agua, conectividad, educacion).

steps.text_en: Hybrid solar and storage projects plus modular solar schools and water systems for off-grid and on-grid clients.
steps.text_es: Proyectos solares hibridos con almacenamiento, aulas solares modulares y sistemas de agua para clientes fuera y dentro de la red.
